$comment: Ground truth established by reading each repository directly, WITHOUT running
Lyse. This is the only reference in the repo that Lyse's own output was not
used to produce, which is what makes it an oracle rather than a snapshot.
`components` counts COMPONENT FILES, not top-level component directories. An
earlier revision of this file counted directories and reported mantine as a
3.7x over-count; measured against files it is 1.44x. Lyse's inventory is
are real components, so directories are the wrong yardstick. Getting this
wrong makes the harness cry wolf, and a harness that cries wolf gets ignored.
`heldOut: true` means the repo is NOT in .bench-corpus, so it took no part in
rule calibration. Regressions caught on a held-out repo are real; regressions
caught on an in-corpus repo may be train-on-test artefacts.

method.react: distinct PascalCase *.tsx/*.jsx basenames under the DS source root, excluding .test/.spec/.story/.stories/.demo/.pure/.e2e
method.vue: component directories under packages/components — Vue SFC filenames are lowercase, so a PascalCase filename count returns zero
method.none: 0 — the repo ships no design system

tolerance.$comment: Accepted when the reported count lands in [components / factorLow, components * factorHigh]. Measured 2026-08-02, every repo sits between 0.80x and 1.44x, so this band is roughly 2x looser than current behaviour in both directions — wide enough not to fire on ordinary drift, narrow enough that zero-where-there-should-be-hundreds cannot pass.
